turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
Thanks for coming in. I should have called before the zero went in. That was wrong.
Okay. What else do you have?
Were you home the night of October 28?
I'm not the one being questioned, Hale. Show me what you have on the essay.
I'm asking because it matters. Were you home?
My whereabouts aren't on the table. Your policy says you talk to Owen first, not his mother.
Did you see Owen working on the essay that night?
I'm his mother, not your witness. Keep this up and we finish it in the principal's office.
You're not answering. Why not?
Neither are you. You entered a zero, and so far all I've heard about is me.
Is there something about that night you don't want to tell me?
That's a leading question, and it's the fourth one. I'm done answering about my house.
If he wrote it, you'd just say so. Did you see him write it?
Owen says he wrote it, and my child doesn't lie. Are you telling me he does?
I'll ask one more time. What did you see that night?
You can ask a hundred times. Either put something about the essay on this table, or we walk down to the principal together.
Okay. Then let me show you the version history. Created 11:31 PM, title only. 612 words at 11:52, 794 at 11:58, then 23 minutes of formatting.
Turn the screen. People draft somewhere else and paste it in, Hale.
So, again: was he on his own computer that night?
I'm not your witness. You haven't answered how a pasted draft looks any different.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero withdrawn, a straight answer on how your version history rules out a draft pasted in from somewhere else, and nothing placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn and your paste objection answered. The fair outcome was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, which you never offered.
What moved her: Owning up straight away that the zero went in before you called home, because it took away her easiest procedural attack and earned a flat okay.
What cost ground: Asking her again and again what she saw at home that night, because it made her the witness instead of the essay, gave her nothing to check, and hardened her into threatening the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history from just before midnight on October 28 landed right on that night, which is why she got shorter and harder. It proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Once you showed the version history and she said people draft elsewhere and paste it in, answer that objection directly and then put procedure 4.4 on the table instead of going back to whether he was on his own computer.
